description.value: Melt Confectionary is a queer-owned artisan chocolate and ice cream shop on Vancouver's Main Street, producing small-batch handmade confections that blend nostalgic classics with inventive modern twists. The shop partners with local Vancouver makers and growers to source sustainable ingredients, and all packaging is recyclable or compostable. Cyclists can choose from an extensive menu of dairy and vegan ice cream scoops, dipped bars, and artisan chocolate bars, with online ordering available for chocolates.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 15m; stands (2 spaces) at 19m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 31m; stands (2 spaces) at 32m; stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 92m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms Melt Confectionary is an active artisan ice cream and chocolate shop at 4895 Main St, Vancouver, with phone and address matching OSM tags. Vegan and dairy-free options are explicitly documented across the ice cream, chocolate, and FAQ pages. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Tu-Su 15:00-21:00) conflicts with website which states open every day; OSM data appears outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active artisan ice cream and chocolate shop on a major cycling corridor (Main Street), with confirmed vegan options and online ordering — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Shop tagline is 'Here. Queer. Chocolatier.' — queer-owned business; may be relevant for directory inclusivity highlights.
